methods.name: Treasury time-series comparison
methods.why: Compare annual and decade shares, documenting gaps, units and administrative changes rather than attributing all registered silver to a single mine.

methods.name: Historical linkage and geodesic distance
methods.why: Document town–treasury pairings by period and calculate straight-line distances with uncertainty; nearest treasury is not proof of service.
methods.tools: QGIS or Python GeoPandas and pyproj

next_steps: Identify documented treasury catchments and check ledger metadata before allocating silver to districts.
Compare distance estimates for uncertain or changing service assignments.
